'''Milessa Arranda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and the mother of [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]].

==Biography==
Milessa Arranda was born and raised on Alderaan, and married [[Kalf Arranda]]. Milessa and Kalf eventually raised two children, [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she and her husband sent their children away from their world for what was intended to be a brief vacation. During the children's absence, Milessa was killed along with every other person on the planet, when [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Grand Moff Tarkin]] used the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] to [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroy Alderaan]] as an example of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] might.
